## History

Prissy Andrews was a student who famously sat up half the night cramming for her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. She attended the local school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) under the instruction of Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). Later, under Miss Stacy's guidance, she traveled to town with her classmates to take the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Prissy Andrews is a student of the local schoolteacher, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). Their dynamic extends beyond the classroom into a romantic courtship, marked by his gifts of flowers and flattering compliments toward her. Though he maintains his role as her instructor, he shows clear favor and affection toward her.
